description: Communes concernées par le risque de mouvement de terrain Finistère is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geobretagne.fr. The dataset contains the municipalities of Finistère exposed to the risk of land movement. This identification was established as part of the development of the departmental file of major risks (D.D.R.M.) by the Prefecture of Finistère. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Municipalities affected by the risk of movement of land Finistère" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include sdis29. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
